{
  "type_map": {
    "dur": "float",
    "proto": "nominal",
    "service": "nominal",
    "state": "nominal",
    "spkts": "integer",
    "dpkts": "integer",
    "sbytes": "integer",
    "dbytes": "integer",
    "rate": "float",
    "sttl": "integer",
    "dttl": "integer",
    "sload": "float",
    "dload": "float",
    "sloss": "integer",
    "dloss": "integer",
    "sinpkt": "float",
    "dinpkt": "float",
    "sjit": "float",
    "djit": "float",
    "swin": "integer",
    "stcpb": "integer",
    "dtcpb": "integer",
    "dwin": "integer",
    "tcprtt": "float",
    "synack": "float",
    "ackdat": "float",
    "smean": "integer",
    "dmean": "integer",
    "trans_depth": "integer",
    "response_body_len": "integer",
    "ct_srv_src": "integer",
    "ct_state_ttl": "integer",
    "ct_dst_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_src_dport_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_dst_sport_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_dst_src_ltm": "integer",
    "is_ftp_login": "binary",
    "ct_ftp_cmd": "integer",
    "ct_flw_http_mthd": "integer",
    "ct_src_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_srv_dst": "integer",
    "is_sm_ips_ports": "binary"
  },
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "np.where(df['dur'] > 0, np.isclose(df['sload'], df['sbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8), df['sload'] == 0)"
      ],
      "features": ["sload", "sbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Sload is defined as source bits per second, so it should equal sbytes*8/dur."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "np.where(df['dur'] > 0, np.isclose(df['dload'], df['dbytes'] * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8), df['dload'] == 0)"
      ],
      "features": ["dload", "dbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Dload is defined as destination bits per second, so it should equal dbytes*8/dur."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == df['sbytes'] // df['spkts'])",
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == np.floor(df['sbytes'] / df['spkts']))",
        "(df['spkts'] > 0) & (df['smean'] == np.round(df['sbytes'] / df['spkts']))"
      ],
      "features": ["smean", "sbytes", "spkts"],
      "rationale": "smean is the mean packet size from source, defined as total source bytes divided by source packet count."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == df['dbytes'] // df['dpkts'])",
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == np.floor(df['dbytes'] / df['dpkts']))",
        "(df['dpkts'] > 0) & (df['dmean'] == np.round(df['dbytes'] / df['dpkts']))"
      ],
      "features": ["dmean", "dbytes", "dpkts"],
      "rationale": "dmean is the mean packet size from destination, defined as total destination bytes divided by destination packet count."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['spkts'] > 1) & np.isclose(df['sinpkt'], df['dur'] / (df['spkts'] - 1), rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["sinpkt", "dur", "spkts"],
      "rationale": "sinpkt is the source interpacket arrival time, typically computed as total duration divided by (number of packets - 1)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dpkts'] > 1) & np.isclose(df['dinpkt'], df['dur'] / (df['dpkts'] - 1), rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["dinpkt", "dur", "dpkts"],
      "rationale": "dinpkt is the destination interpacket arrival time, typically computed as total duration divided by (number of packets - 1)."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['tcprtt'], df['synack'] + df['ackdat'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["tcprtt", "synack", "ackdat"],
      "rationale": "tcprtt is explicitly defined as the sum of synack and ackdat."
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['sbytes'] + df['dbytes']) * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['spkts'] + df['dpkts']) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['sbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)",
        "(df['dur'] > 0) & np.isclose(df['rate'], df['dbytes'] / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)"
      ],
      "features": ["rate", "sbytes", "dbytes", "spkts", "dpkts", "dur"],
      "rationale": "rate is undocumented; plausible definitions include total bits per second, total packets per second, or per-direction byte rates."
    }
  ]
}
